m_f5859629bcfd.en: Image, PDF, ZIP, QR, Markdown, color, unit conversion, text comparison and OCR processing happen in your browser. ZIP contents are checked and extracted locally; archive files are never uploaded. Password Generator uses cryptographic randomness and does not save, log or upload generated passwords or word passphrases. Copying a password places it on your device clipboard. Images, PDF files, QR content, Wi-Fi passwords and logos are not uploaded or saved to your workspace. QR appearance presets contain only colors and size. OCR downloads only the language packs you choose, and caches them in your browser. Existing text tools send text to cloud storage only when you explicitly save a signed-in draft. Answer Book and Decision Studio automatically save new or edited records: locally first, then privately to your signed-in account. Answer Book questions are never saved. Guest history is not automatically uploaded when you sign in.
m_f5859629bcfd.zh-Hant: 圖片、PDF、ZIP、QR、Markdown、色彩、單位換算、文字比較及 OCR 都在瀏覽器中處理。ZIP 內容在本機檢查與解壓縮，壓縮包不會上傳。Password Generator 使用密碼學安全隨機數，不會儲存、記錄或上傳產生的密碼或單詞口令。複製密碼會將它放入裝置的剪貼簿。圖片、PDF 檔案、QR 內容、Wi-Fi 密碼及 Logo 不會上傳或儲存至工作區。QR 外觀預設只包含色彩與尺寸。OCR 只下載你選擇的語言包，並快取在瀏覽器中。既有文字工具只會在你明確儲存已登入的草稿時，將文字傳至雲端。Answer Book 和 Decision Studio 會自動儲存新增或編輯的記錄：先存於本機，再私下同步至已登入的帳號。答案之書的問題不會儲存。登入時不會自動上傳訪客歷史。

m_3278d37d88cb.en: Learning cards, review mastery and due dates are stored in IndexedDB on this device. Signed-in card decks sync privately to your account; guest decks are not automatically uploaded. Private decks are excluded from public profiles. Conflicts retain copies, and deleted cloud decks keep empty synchronization tombstones. Calculator history stays on this device. File checksums, subtitle files and local preview videos are processed here without uploads. Download subtitle edits before leaving. PDF information cleanup covers the standard Info dictionary and document/page XMP only.
m_3278d37d88cb.zh-Hant: 學習卡、複習熟練度及到期日期儲存在此裝置的 IndexedDB。登入後，牌組會私下同步至帳號，訪客牌組不會自動上傳。私人牌組不會出現在公開個人檔案。衝突時會保留副本；已刪除的雲端牌組會留下不含內容的同步刪除標記。計算機歷史只保留在此裝置。檔案校驗碼、字幕檔及本機預覽影片都在這裡處理，不會上傳。離開前請下載字幕修改。PDF 資訊清理僅涵蓋標準 Info 字典及文件／頁面的 XMP。
